description: Get user reviews of an app: star rating, date, text and app version; on Google Play also helpful votes and the developer's reply, on the App Store a review title. Read live from the store. For questions about what users say, like, dislike or complain about in an app, or about its 1-star / 5-star reviews (set stars). If the user gives an app name instead of an id, find the id with search_apps first.

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. com.instagram.android) or numeric App Store id (e.g. 389801252).

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166 store country code. Defaults to US.

sort.description: Order: most_relevant (default), newest or rating (rating is Google Play only).

stars.description: Optional: only reviews with this star rating (1-5), e.g. 1 for complaints.

name: get_app_reviews
title: Get app reviews
